about: Every system that raises the team power (전투력) the game shows for a lineup, as the sources list them (nv:33130, nv:43444, the in-game Arena guide quoted by web:sugarpocket-guides). For each: what it raises, where it applies, its materials and whether they are free, time-gated or paid, its cap and diminishing returns, posted gains, efficiency by account stage, and what it does for the stage and Rift brackets of record 003. 'posted' figures are players' own; 'inferred' ones are this record's arithmetic on posted or game-data figures. A gain marked 'damage, not power' is a score or stat change in a mode where power decides nothing (Guild Conquest, Arena, the 15% stage line). Game version 1.5.002 (2026-10-08) unless a patch note says otherwise.
efficiency_scale: high: a posted or inferred gain of several % of team power for a cost a player at that stage meets within days; medium: about 1% per few days' income or per ~10,000 KRW; low: well under 1% per the same, or gated by luck or large sums; none: no displayed power.

sources_list.bracket_effect: The main driver in mid-game; also where power padding lives (see lineup). At the 15% line the damage preset clears faster than the power preset.
sources_list.spend_order: Mileage and exchanges: dough keys first (nv:30148, web:yt-s4Y3glSPJPk); auto-draw one tier below the best rate (web:yt-EocpkOD5NW0). Keep presets per mode (web:yt-HcVx3n0gjpQ, nv:51157, dc:84572, dc:83818). Conquest: weapons skill amp + crit dmg (or crit rate or ATK, disputed), armour damage reduction + HP, upper accessories skill haste + skill amp, lower accessories damage reduction + skill haste; no accuracy, focus or crit resistance. Arena: the same with crit resistance on armour and lower accessories. Stage: accuracy and focus to the stage's line, then power. Oven filter: skill amp and damage reduction, one valid line per slot group (dc:83807).
sources_list.patch_notes: 2026-08-13 auto-open up to 20 by oven level; 2026-08-27 up to 50 (web:crumbgg-patches-20260928); 2026-10-02 200/300/400/500 at oven 32/34/36/38, 100 gear held (nv:48486). sources_list.name_en: Mercenary band level, captain and perks
sources_list.raises: The leader gets a flat +10% ATK/DEF/HP from band Lv.1 (the wiki's Effects column is cumulative, not per level); perks add damage: Passion Pay +20% ATK (−20% HP) to the highest-ATK ally, Rapid Promotion +7% ATK to the same, Like A Family +2% elemental damage per cookie of the main element. Band Lv.4 opens a second perk slot. No displayed power (web:cookierun-wiki-mercenary-guild).

sources_list.bracket_effect: None on the bracket; real damage within it.
sources_list.spend_order: Speed-ups into band Lv.4, then Passion Pay on the ATK #1 ally (Milk in record 001's decks) for Conquest and the Crumble Dungeon, with Rapid Promotion or All Ammo Provided as the second perk (dc:83383, dc:83916, dc:84626, dc:83720). Perks are one setting for every mode, so players swap them by hand before Conquest and accept weaker Arena defence meanwhile (dc:84603, dc:84965); three-tank perks carried one team past the 17 s wipe (dc:84330). Whether perks apply on Arena defence is disputed (dc:84480); 1.5.002 added the rule to the Arena pop-up (web:cookierun-wiki-patch-1-5).
sources_list.patch_notes: 1.5.002: the Arena information pop-up now explains how Mercenary Guild effects apply (web:cookierun-wiki-patch-1-5).
